blockers.B-HOST: No Windows or macOS host with Chrome is available: the executor is Linux x86_64 with no devices.
blockers.B-ACCOUNT: No standard non-admin test account (and no freshly created one) is available on a Windows/macOS host.
blockers.B-CANDIDATE: No approved production release descriptor (config/release-<platform>.json is untracked because the Web Store extension ID is not approved) and therefore no signed, notarized candidate or release anchor exists; signing credentials and the protected release job have not been supplied.
blockers.B-SECOND-RELEASE: A second signed release (older and newer, with controllable host API ranges) does not exist; upgrade, failed-upgrade, rollback and compatibility need both.
blockers.B-ATTENDED: An attended person must grant or deny Bluetooth consent and observe the OS/Chrome grant state; none is available.
blockers.B-DEV-BUILD: A separately compiled development host and an unpacked development extension ID are required and have not been built on a native runner.
blockers.B-TRUST-FIXTURES: Offline trust cases need a controllable network, an OS-level denial and a descriptor that denies a known payload digest; no owner-authorised trust fixtures exist.
